title: Universal scaling of finite-temperature quantum adiabaticity in driven many-body systems
summary: Establishing quantitative adiabaticity criteria at finite temperature remains substantially less developed than in the pure-state setting, even though realistic quantum systems are never at absolute zero. Here, by combining a mixed-state quantum speed limit with mixed-state fidelity susceptibility within the Liouville-space formulation of quantum mechanics, we derive rigorous bounds on the Hilbert-Schmidt fidelity between mixed states.
